Designed for Meta Quest 3 & 3S · Mixed-reality prototype · Tested on the headset September 18, 2026

MEET DEE IN THE LOUNGE

Arrive. Say hi.
Take the tour.

A whiteboard lights up in your room and Dee, a live voice guide, is already talking. Six stops later you know the wall, the pages, the scenery and the settings, and your first lesson is one press away.

WATCH THE DEMO

Eighty seconds
on the headset.

Arrival, the tour, Cargo Crew’s halves and quarters, a round at the café, a bed in the garden, and back to the wall. Recorded on a Quest 3S; the passthrough shows the tester’s room.

LESS MEMORIZING. MORE MAKING SENSE.

Not just looking at math.
Getting your hands on it.

Some ideas need more than a page. Bring them into your space, where every piece has a purpose and every action tells a story.

01 / SEE IT

The abstract,
made tangible.

A whole container. Two equal halves. Four quarters. See the size of each piece alongside its fraction.

02 / TRY IT

A small world.
A meaningful job.

You’re the load planner at Dock 7. Split crates and pack delivery vehicles with the right share of one container.

03 / TALK IT THROUGH

Questions welcome.
Guidance nearby.

Ask your AI dock partner for help, replay a demonstration, or move to the next chapter by voice.

YOUR FIRST ADVENTURE

Welcome to Cargo Crew.

The dock is busy. The trucks are waiting.
Every delivery starts with understanding the whole.

Five chapters connect wholes, halves, quarters, equivalent fractions, and topping up a load. Wrong loads stay editable—try, compare, and try again.

A VOICE IN YOUR CORNER

A guide that’s
in the moment.

Meet Dee. Not a prerecorded tour—a conversational AI partner connected to the chapter you’re in and the pieces on your workbench.

  • Ask in your own words. Get help with the lesson or request another demonstration.
  • Keep your hands in the experience. Say “split it,” “check my load,” or “next chapter.”
  • The math stays grounded. The game checks the quantities; the AI explains the result.

Voice is optional. On-screen controls remain available when the guide is paused or offline.

CURIOSITY HAS MORE PLACES TO GO

New worlds. Familiar ideas.

Beyond the dock, two more lessons bring arithmetic into everyday stories.

DIVISION

Neighborhood Café

Deal pastries onto plates a round at a time, pack orders into full boxes, and check the order when every plate holds the same. Five chapters, 6 ÷ 2 to a fact family.

Playable · Tested on Quest 3S, September 18, 2026
MULTIPLICATION

Community Garden

Plant seedling strips row by row, turn the bed to see 3 × 4 become 4 × 3, and split a bed with a fence. Accepted rows sprout. Five chapters.

Playable · Tested on Quest 3S, September 18, 2026

YOUR ROOM. A NEW WAY TO EXPLORE.

A little wonder.
A whole new perspective.

A hands-on math adventure, built in Unity for Meta Quest.
Start with fractions. See where curiosity takes you.

About this prototype

This hackathon project is currently demonstrated with adult testers, not available as a public app-store release. Learning outcomes have not yet been evaluated. Child-facing release requires age-appropriate access, privacy, and safety review.
